verdict.rationale: Clerk's own docs and pricing describe drop-in `<SignIn/>` and `<SignUp/>` components, prebuilt UIs for sign-up, sign-in and user profile, and profile and security settings management. They also say the UI components can be customized to match your branding with any CSS library. The GitHub repo backs up the sign-up, sign-in and profile management scope, and the community comments raise no specific failure of these components. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of hosted pages as an alternative (only "deploy to your own domain" hints at it), detailed evidence of how deep customization goes, and independent hands-on reports of using the components in production.

support.subject: As a developer, I can ship production sign-in, sign-up, and profile management with prebuilt, customizable UI components or hosted pages
